groupings.title: Web Quality
groupings.description: Browser-based QA skills for auditing user experience, accessibility, links, console errors, SEO, forms, localization, cross-browser behavior, and HTTPS hygiene.

groupings.title: Performance
groupings.description: Web performance skills for measuring Core Web Vitals, page weight, third-party bloat, and cold-load bottlenecks.

groupings.title: Code Review
groupings.description: Repository review skills for evidence-backed audits, risky diffs, API contract drift, leaked secrets, dependency risk, dead code, complexity hotspots, and weak error handling.

groupings.title: Test Review
groupings.description: Test-suite review skills for finding coverage gaps, weak tests, visual regressions, brittle UI selectors, and ineffective CI gates.

groupings.title: Naughty Strings
groupings.description: Skills inspired by the Big List of Naughty Strings: reserved values and numeric coercion, real names and emails wrongly rejected, and invisible or deceptive Unicode in code and agent files.

groupings.title: Security & Compliance
groupings.description: A unified read-only security pack for repositories and websites, current exploited vulnerabilities, Railway exposure, advisory applicability, LLM apps, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, and dependency licenses.
